name: tomtom-mcp
description: Provide real-time geospatial context from TomTom - including maps, routing, search geocoding and traffic.
long_description: The TomTom Maps MCP Server simplifies geospatial development by providing seamless access to TomTom's location services, including search, routing, traffic, and dynamic map rendering with native modules bundled.

tools.name: tomtom-discover-places
tools.description: Find places, businesses and POIs anywhere, in a named area, near a point, or along a route, with live EV charger availability

tools.name: tomtom-locate-place
tools.description: Resolve one named place, address or landmark to coordinates, optionally with its boundary polygon

tools.name: tomtom-poi-categories
tools.description: Look up POI category codes from natural language

tools.name: tomtom-plan-route
tools.description: Calculate a route through named places or coordinates, with live traffic and optional EV charging stops

tools.name: tomtom-find-reachable-areas
tools.description: Determine the areas reachable from one or more origins within time, distance, energy or fuel budgets

tools.name: tomtom-get-traffic
tools.description: Report traffic incidents, accidents, road closures and congestion in a named area or bounding box

tools.name: tomtom-dynamic-map
tools.description: Render a map with markers, drawn lines, polygons, and area overlays

tools.name: tomtom-data-viz
tools.description: Visualize custom GeoJSON data on a TomTom basemap with markers, heatmaps, clusters, lines, and choropleth maps

tomtom_api_key.title: TomTom API Key
tomtom_api_key.description: Your TomTom API key used to authenticate with TomTom services.
